features.quote: **Turn cap**: 40 tool-call turns (pilot will tell you where 90% of onsets occur; expect 8–25). Hard token cap as backstop.
Do **not** early-stop runs on heuristic degradation triggers in the main arm — it censors severity and recovery measurement; allow it only in the regression suite
features.justification_quote: it censors severity and recovery measurement

features.quote: avoid prompt designs gratuitously engineered to maximize that specific content beyond what's needed for reproduction — variant 1–3 mechanisms get you the trigger rate without it.
